summary.purpose: Disable Android Auto Backup and direct device-to-device transfer for translation history and user preferences. Fresh installs of Dashka Translate Lite must start with empty history regardless of whether a previous version was installed on the same Google account.
summary.scope: Manifest + two XML rules files only. No Kotlin, no UI, no Compose, no Gradle.
summary.blocks_resolved: Privacy violation observed in Leanid's field test: second device installing v0.4.6-mama via Telegram inherited 6 history entries (14:10 timestamps) from a different device's v0.4.6-history-dedup install on the same Google account.

investigation_summary.field_evidence: Three photos provided by Leanid: (1) phone 1 with v0.4.6-history-dedup showing 6 entries / 14:10; (2) Android Studio with fresh v0.4.6-mama build showing empty history; (3) phone 2 with v0.4.6-mama installed from Telegram showing the same 6 entries / 14:10 from phone 1.
investigation_summary.kimi_initial_hypothesis: Pre-bundled history files in APK assets/ or res/raw/.
investigation_summary.claude_forensic_verification: Independent code search confirmed: no assets/ directory exists, no res/raw/ directory exists, no .json or .db files anywhere in repo, no hardcoded entries in Kotlin, no Room or SQLite usage, only runtime DataStore writes.
investigation_summary.true_root_cause: AndroidManifest.xml line 18: android:allowBackup="true" enables Android Auto Backup. DataStore Preferences files under /data/data/com.solar.dashka/files/datastore/ are automatically backed up to Google Drive (keyed by applicationId + signing certificate + Google account), and automatically restored on install on any device with the same account. Android Studio emulator avoided this because emulator typically has no Google account configured AND/OR uses debug signing certificate that mismatches the release backup.
investigation_summary.kimi_direction_correct: Privacy framing and severity assessment were correct.
investigation_summary.kimi_technical_specifics_corrected: Bundled-APK hypothesis was not verified by code search; actual root cause is one layer deeper (OS-level Auto Backup, not in-APK content).

app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.change_kind: Flip allowBackup true→false; wire dataExtractionRules + fullBackupContent attributes.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.diff_summary: Three attribute changes on the <application> element. Everything else (FileProvider, MainActivity, permissions, queries) untouched.

app/src/main/res/xml/backup_rules.xml.purpose: Legacy backup configuration for Android 6.0 – 11.x. Belt-and-braces second line of defense behind allowBackup=false. Explicitly excludes datastore/dashka_history.preferences_pb and datastore/dashka_user_prefs.preferences_pb, plus the entire datastore/ directory as safety net.

app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rul.purpose: Modern backup configuration for Android 12+. Configures BOTH cloud-backup and device-transfer destinations with global excludes plus explicit DataStore excludes. Without device-transfer rules, the Android setup wizard's 'Copy apps & data' could carry history forward to a new phone.

risks.build: ZERO — no code, no Gradle, no dependencies changed; manifest schema and XML are stable Android API
risks.type_check: N/A — no Kotlin or Java touched
risks.runtime_regression: ZERO — DataStore reads and writes behave identically; only their backup eligibility changes
risks.current_users_data_loss: ZERO — existing on-device history is preserved across update; only future fresh installs differ
risks.existing_google_drive_backups: Become passive after this release. Drive expires backups automatically after ~60 days of inactivity from the original app. New version with allowBackup=false will not write new backup, and on reinstall will not read existing one (Android backup manager respects the new manifest).
risks.play_console_impact: Listing's 'Data safety' form should now correctly state 'no data backed up'. If form was previously submitted as 'data backed up', requires update.
risks.edge_case_dual_use: If a user runs v0.4.6-history-dedup (old) and v0.4.7-fix (new) on two devices with same Google account, the OLD device may still write backups. NEW device will refuse to read them. No data corruption possible — old and new use the same DataStore files locally, only backup transport differs.
risks.edge_case_oem_quirk: Some historical OEM Android distributions (older Samsung One UI, Xiaomi MIUI) have been documented to occasionally ignore allowBackup=false. Explicit excludes in both XML files cover this scenario as defense in depth.

scenario_A_fresh_install.action: Install v0.4.7-fix on any device that has never had Dashka installed.
scenario_A_fresh_install.expected: History list is empty. App requires user to make first translation before any entry appears.

scenario_B_first_use_after_install.expected: History shows 2 entries in newest-first order, each with correct flags, source/translated text, voice, and timestamp.

scenario_C_uninstall_reinstall_same_devi.action: Uninstall v0.4.7-fix from device, then reinstall the same APK.
scenario_C_uninstall_reinstall_same_devi.expected: History is empty. Previous data NOT restored from Google Drive (allowBackup=false prevents both write and read).

scenario_D_install_on_second_device_same.action: On a second physical device signed into the same Google account, install v0.4.7-fix (e.g., from Telegram).
scenario_D_install_on_second_device_same.expected: History is empty. No cross-device restore.

scenario_E_update_existing_install.action: On a device running v0.4.6-history-dedup with existing history, update to v0.4.7-fix.
scenario_E_update_existing_install.expected: History preserved (Android update does not wipe data dir). User keeps their data on this device. No cross-device restore occurs from this point on.
scenario_E_update_existing_install.intentional_non_wipe: Option A — clean break does NOT clear existing-device data.

scenario_F_device_transfer_wizard.action: User runs Android 12+ 'Copy apps & data' wizard from old phone to new phone.
scenario_F_device_transfer_wizard.expected: Dashka is restored (so it appears as installed app), but with empty data (device-transfer rules exclude all data domains).

steps: On a device that has never had Dashka installed, install v0.4.7-fix APK.
Tap the History (clock) icon in the top app bar.
verification_checklist_per_dashka_reques.expected_result: History bottom sheet shows empty state — no entries.

steps: From state at end of VER-A, perform RU→PL translation: type "Привет", tap → Польский.
Tap swap button, type "Cześć", tap → Русский.
verification_checklist_per_dashka_reques.expected_result: History shows exactly 2 entries, newest first.

steps: From state at end of VER-B, uninstall Dashka completely (long-press → uninstall).
verification_checklist_per_dashka_reques.expected_result: History is empty. No restore from Google Drive.

steps: On phone A: install v0.4.7-fix, make 2 translations (history has 2 entries).
On phone B (different physical device, same Google account): install the same v0.4.7-fix APK (e.g., via Telegram or direct file transfer).
Open the app on phone B, tap History.
verification_checklist_per_dashka_reques.expected_result: History on phone B is empty. Phone A's 2 entries do NOT appear.

steps: Start with v0.4.6-history-dedup installed and 6 history entries.
Install v0.4.7-fix as an update (do not uninstall first).
verification_checklist_per_dashka_reques.expected_result: All 6 existing entries are preserved. User does not lose data when updating.
